[[Elsnil's Frigidheart]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Elsnil Frigidheart]], a [[boss]] in [[Ice Cliff Chasms]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +60

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the [[Icicle Staff]]; however, it is colored a bluish green.
